thread:
Sam (oncall): morning handoff — quick summary of last 6h: we had a short 503 surge hitting API-gateway between 04:12-04:28 UTC. impact: ~1.8% of requests errored, spike concentrated on embeddings route. root cause looks like an embeddings worker autoscaler oscillation + redis eviction flurry. mitigations applied: scaled dedicated embed pool + reverted a recent batching change. link to alert: https://alerts.redwood.internal/alerts/EVT-8921 :wave:
Maria (secondary): hi — confirmed customer-facing 503s around 04:15. biggest hit to small customers (free tier) — no major enterprise incidents, no pager escalations after mitigation. logs show steady retry flood from a small crawler we throttled at the edge.
IncidentBot: Incident EVT-8921 created at 04:13 UTC. Severity: S2. Pages: sam@redwood and maria@redwood. Actions logged: added embed-pool-scaling policy override.
Alex (sre): I left a short runbook note in playbook: https://playbooks.redwood.internal/embed-autoscale-oscillation — tl;dr: if embed RPS > 12k and backend queue depth > 500, apply `--min-instances=6` and pause scale-to-zero.
Priya (eng): FYI I rolled back batching commit `feat/embedding-batch-adjust` at 04:20 because it increased per-request latency under load. snapshot of revert command: ```git checkout main && git revert -m 1 f6b3a2c``` deploy bot kicked off.
Jenkins (deploy-bot): deploy main@2026-03-15T04:22 triggered by Priya. status: success.
Sam (oncall): after deploy we saw error rate drop to baseline by 04:28. embedding p95 dropped from 980ms -> 240ms. KV eviction logs spiking before rollback, so likely the batching change increased memory pressure on embed workers.
Maria (secondary): open items: reconcile exact RU costs for affected customers (Liam will correlate billing spikes). also need to check if our autoscaler cooldown is too aggressive for short bursts.
Liam (support): I pulled the customer impact list — ~21 customers had 2+ failed requests, 3 had >50. I emailed the top 3 owners about transient errors and offered SLA credits if they want.
Alex (sre): action items I left: 1) add a temporary autoscaler override for embeddings for next 24h, 2) increase redis eviction threshold by 10% on embed-workers (config `redis.maxmemory-policy`), 3) enable extra observability for kv hit/miss per tenant.
Priya (eng): timeline note: batching change was intended to reduce cost for long-tail small requests by increasing batch window to 50ms. under bursty traffic it aggregated hot prefixes causing KV cache pressure. patch idea is to make window adaptive by prefix-entropy. I'll spike a fix today.
Sam (oncall): current status at handoff: all services green, no active pager. autoscaler override still active (embed-min=6). monitoring on 15m cadence for next 6h. link to dashboards: https://console.redwood.internal/dashboards/embed-pool and https://console.redwood.internal/dashboards/edge-errors
IncidentBot: EVT-8921 status changed to monitoring at 04:35 UTC.
Maria (secondary): coverage for next shift: Sam remains primary until 12:00 UTC, Maria secondary until 12:00, then @Alex becomes primary for the evening shift and @Priya will be secondary. please acknowledge.
Alex (sre): acknowledge. I'll be primary @12:00 UTC. plan to: keep autoscaler override until I do a controlled ramp-down tomorrow; run a 2hr soak test at lower RPS and watch eviction metrics; follow up with infra config change if needed.
Sam (oncall): next steps list (short):
- Priya: implement adaptive batching spike and open PR by EOD. (PR link to follow)
- Alex: scheduled soak test + decide on autoscaler rollback window (tomorrow morning).
- Liam: send customer follow-ups and compile impact sheet for AM ops meeting.
- Maria: update runbook with explicit steps for short surge (added note under 'embed-autoscale-oscillation').
- Me (Sam): monitor dashboards for 6h, check alerts on high tail latency and redis evictions.
Priya (eng): quick note about runbook text — suggest adding `kubectl` snippet to adjust min-instances quickly: ```kubectl -n inference scale deployment embed-worker --replicas=6``` and a one-liner to rollback batching: ```deploy rollback feat/embedding-batch-adjust```
Maria (secondary): coverage gap: if Alex is on-call tomorrow morning he might be in timezone travel. plan B: @Sam will be reachable until 14:00 UTC. please confirm availability.
Alex (sre): I'm home but online — fine for tomorrow AM call. if I can't attend, set Priya as acting primary.
Liam (support): I uploaded the customer impact CSV to the incident folder: https://drive.redwood.internal/EVT-8921/impact.csv. added brief notes on who wants follow-up.
Taylor (pm): quick product note — a couple customers asked about retry behavior. can we add a short FAQ blurb for status page? if yes, I'll post and pin it.
Sam (oncall): yes, please craft a short blurb: 'Transient 503s for embeddings route between 04:12-04:28 UTC caused by autoscaler cooldown + batching change; service restored and we are monitoring. Reach support if you saw persistent errors.' Taylor take it.
IncidentBot: EVT-8921 annotated with postmortem tag: postmortem-required=false (S2 with no customer downtime).
Maria (secondary): final handoff checklist: confirm all actions have owners, update #incidents with summary for leadership, and close incident thread once Alex confirms autoscaler rollback schedule.
Sam (oncall): ACK — handing off to Alex at 12:00 UTC. I'll leave my pager on until 12:30 for any regressions. thanks team :thumbsup:
